CFO approval is required. Under the VOS-7 approval matrix, a projected annual spend above Rs 10,00,000 requires CFO approval; direct-material vendors (any value) require Plant Head and QA; all other vendors require GM Procurement.

Nil - no discount applies. Under PP-2023, a single order below Rs 5,00,000 attracts no discount; Rs 5,00,000 to Rs 15,00,000 attracts 10% and above Rs 15,00,000 attracts 14%. Slab discounts are not cumulative with scheme or campaign discounts unless expressly stated.
A restocking charge of 10% of invoice value applies to unused goods in original packing returned within 30 days of despatch; made-to-order items are not returnable.
